answer: An identity earns its seat through Licensed sanitation inspector drain record with sanitation inspectors verification, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 579 fakes pay 579 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. One ledge of signal, one grove of cost, one ember of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
